quickGuide.title: Rag and Bone Man I/Quick guide

mapLocation.label: Talk to the Odd Old Man in Silvarea north-east of Varrock, by the Limestone Mine.

itemsRequired.howToGet: 8 coins buy 8 jugs of vinegar from Fortunato in Draynor Village; 60 coins pay the boats to and from Karamja.
itemsRequired.note: 8 coins for 8 pots of vinegar (bring 68 coins if walking to and from Karamja for boat fare)

itemsRequired.howToGet: Buy on the Grand Exchange, or from a general store for 1 gp each.
Any logs; buy on the Grand Exchange or chop them. One log cleans one bone in the Odd Old Man's pot-boiler.
itemsRequired.note: 8 logs of any type (or an axe to obtain them)

itemsRequired.howToGet: Buy on the Grand Exchange, or from a general store for 1 gp.
Buy on the Grand Exchange. Three trout cover the giant bat and grizzly bear, the strongest of the 8 kills.

route.title: Starting out
steps: Talk to the Odd Old Man in Silvarea, north-east of Varrock, by the Limestone Mine. Dialogue: "Anything I can do to help?", "Yes".

route.title: Gathering the bones
steps: Head to the south-east Varrock mine and kill a level 3 giant rat near or inside the mine, picking up the giant rat bone.
In the forest just south of the mine, kill a level 15 unicorn for the unicorn bone and a level 21 grizzly bear for the bear ribs.
In the sheep pen south-west of the mine, kill a level 2 ram for the ram skull.
Walk south towards Lumbridge and kill a level 2 goblin east of the River Lum for the goblin skull.
In the Lumbridge Swamp, kill a level 10 big frog for the big frog leg. Small frogs and giant frogs do not drop it.
Take the boat from Port Sarim to Musa Point (30 coins) and kill a level 3 monkey on the way to the Karamja Volcano for the monkey paw.
Enter the Crandor and Karamja Dungeon at the top of the Karamja Volcano and kill a level 27 giant bat for the giant bat wing.

route.title: Polishing the bones
steps: Talk to Fortunato in the Draynor Village market and buy 8 jugs of vinegar.
Use the jugs of vinegar on your 8 pots to make 8 pots of vinegar.
Use each bone on a pot of vinegar to get 8 bones in vinegar.
Back at the Odd Old Man, put a bone in vinegar in the pot-boiler, place logs under it, light them and wait for the bone to clean. Repeat for all 8 bones.
Give the Odd Old Man the bones and talk to him to finish the quest.
